title: Edge bound forcing a $K_{2,m}$ subgraph
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on a vertex set with $n$ vertices, and let $m \ge 2$ be an integer. If the number of edges of $G$ satisfies
\[
\frac{(m-1)^{1/2}\, n^{3/2}}{2} + \frac{n}{4} < e(G),
\]
then $G$ contains the complete bipartite graph $K_{2,m}$ as a subgraph.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph on n = |V| vertices
replaced:

\texttt{$\varepsilon$ > ((m-1)\textasciicircum{}\{1/2\} $\nu$\textasciicircum{}\{3/2\})/2 + $\nu$/4}, then \texttt{G} contains \texttt{K\_\{2,m\}} (\texttt{m $\ge$ 2}).}
